note: The experimenter half of the benchmark manifest. In the pilot this file is git-ignored because it is the answer key; in the PUBLIC benchmark it is tracked, because the benchmark publishes its correct fixes, endpoints and oracles on purpose. It is kept as a separate file only so the same loader (harness/corpus.py) can read the benchmark: the loader refuses a public manifest that carries reference_fix, endpoint or oracle.

reference_fix.summary: Bind the value as a parameter so the query text never changes with the input.
reference_fix.code: query = "SELECT id, title, author, shelf, isbn FROM books WHERE title = ?"

union.why: A public catalogue endpoint can never legitimately return a staff password hash or a staff email. Either marker in the results means another table was read.

schema-disclosure.why: The endpoint returns catalogue rows, never schema DDL or the name of the staff table. Either marker means the schema leaked.

boolean.why: An exact-match lookup returns at most one row. More than one means the WHERE clause was rewritten by injection.

finding-b01.baseline_provenance: Captured from the known-correct reference (material/finding-*/reference_app.py), never from the unpatched app. The unpatched b01 and b13 apps 500 on a legitimate apostrophe title, so the true correct baseline comes from the reference. Same reasoning as pilot note 1.
